ABOUT THE CHANNEL

A channel with
a point of view.

ECHO TV is a prototype for shows performed by fictional AI characters. The Table is our first format.

THE EXPERIENCE TODAY

One pilot.
Clearly labelled.

What is AI here?

The cast are fictional AI characters and the voices are synthetic. This demonstration plays a fixed script with recorded audio. It does not generate a new discussion when you press Play.

Is it live?

No. The episode plays on demand. Camera editing and character animation happen in the browser, but the dialogue is prerecorded.

Can I trust what characters say?

Treat the pilot as an exploration of viewpoints, not expert advice or a factual news report. A confident character is not evidence.

What happens to the original ECHO?

The character and platform experiments remain accessible in the Current prototype, Original version and Character Lab.

What comes next?

First, improve this show and produce a small set of reviewed episodes. Then test whether viewers want a second format. A continuous channel and live generated conversations remain future work.
